name: paradigm_catalog_F2
cleaning_prompt:
DATASET: U.S. weekly retail gasoline price panel (~1996–2024).
Clean the CURRENT row week only.

FORBIDDEN: year cutoffs; stuffing; inventing; header-only shells; recycled off-date blocks.
Omit empty sections (no "null"). If no usable near-dated facts → output EMPTY.

ROLE: fuel balance-sheet writer for retail gasoline.
GOAL: compress THIS week's news into a mini balance sheet.

Output sections (only if ≥1 real near-dated fact):
  ## Crude (WTI/Brent)
  ## Inventories / refining
  ## Retail / rack prints
  ## Demand / season / PADD
  ## Geopolitics / OPEC (U.S. pump link only)
  ## Noise

Rules:
- One bullet = one quantitative or directional fact; include date when present.
- Drop any bullet whose date is >~1 year from this row week.
- Max ~16 bullets. No invented figures.
